quest.title: A Gift From the Sea Spirits
quest.description: By the gentle shores of Fontaine, you and Paimon meet a Melusine who needs your help...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Take a walk by the water's edge

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Melusine friend! Need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: #Oh! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's you! Long time no see!

choices.text: Puca! Nice to see you again too.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hehe, right in one! You know me too well.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Everyone in Merusea is preparing a surprise gift for Monsieur Neuvillette. We're working together to make him a new outfit! I was about to go find some gems and shells to decorate it with!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wow, a surprise present!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, a surprise present!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, is it really okay for you to tell us like that, though?

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Ahhh! Oh no...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Sorry, it's my first time doing something like this, so it just slipped out...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: I'm not sure why, but seeing everyone working towards the same goal like this, my heart just won't stop racing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon totally gets it! The mood's just so infectious that you get swept up in the hype and you just can't stop, won't stop, right?

choices.text: It's like forming a band.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Yeah, it is! We may be playing different instruments, but we're playing in harmony, making the same music!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, why'd everyone suddenly decide to give him a gift?

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Oh, that! Monsieur Neuvillette is always sending gifts to everyone in Merusea Village, so after discussing it, we decided to make something for him ourselves!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Flo handled the blueprints, and then we all picked out the materials and sewed it together... And Serene was in charge of "emergency precautions" to prevent things from getting totally out of control.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Emergency precautions? Things getting out of control?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon knows that making clothes with Melusine hands is hard, but how bad could it possibly get?

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: That depends on your definition of bad.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Does it count if we ask Mamere to make a huge painting, and then turn the canvas into pajamas?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh wow. About that...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think Neuvillette would love it.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hehe, me too!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: But like Serene said, it's better if we make a respectable outfit that he can proudly wear when he's out and about!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Laume's got tons of experience, so we had her get a whole bundle of fashion magazines, and asked Sigewinne what "respectable" meant, before we finally settled on "solemn relaxation" as the theme.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Solemn relaxation"... Paimon can't help but picture Neuvillette swimming around with a serious look when she hears that...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Speaking of which, you've still got shells on you, yes?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Oh, right! Shells! I was so busy talking with you, I almost forgot my job...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Sorry, I've gotta go! I can't hold everyone else up because I was enjoying myself too much...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: I need to find some shiny shells and rocks pronto, and grind them up into shiny powder! I'm not sure if I have enough Tidalga for the dye, either...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: In that case, I think it's time for our line...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Leave it to us!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When it comes to finding stuff, we're the best in the biz! As much as you need, on time, guaranteed!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Really? You will? Thank you so much!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Then... Could you please help me find some of the shiniest, brightest Beryl Conches? I remember there's a bunch in the waters around here, two or three should be enough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, even 20 or 30 would be a piece of cake!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Oh, that's way too many!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: I'll focus on finding gems over here! Good luck to us, see you soon!

choices.text: Like co-conspirators committing a crime together.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Definitely not!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's begging you, please don't say things like that in the Nation of Justice...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hmm... Everyone keeping a secret together, doing things quietly... There are some similarities, I guess?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh... If you corrupt Puca, we'll never be able to look Neuvillette in the eye again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, enough of the crime talk! Let's get back to the new clothes.

choices.text: Looking for pretty rocks again?

talks.objective: Find a way to get underwater
Collect the shiniest and brightest Beryl Conches

dialogues.speaker: (Observe)
dialogues.text: Tidalga left by the roadside. It's soaking wet, as though it had just been taken out of the water.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette! Can I ask a question?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Of course you may.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: I've heard that Liyue has fire wrapped in paper, lights that can grant any wish! Is that true?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Fire wrapped in paper? Wouldn't it break? And isn't that dangerous?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's right! If your wish is to burn the whole house down, then it might come true.

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Whoooa, Puca! Where'd you learn to joke like that?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Eh? I wasn't joking...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Well... There is something like that. They're called "Xiao Lanterns."

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: They aren't dangerous if properly handled, but they do not actually have the power to grant wishes... I'm sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: Awww, you don't need to apologize!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Heh... Simply listening to me describe them would be quite dull. How about I bring some back for you once I visit Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: That'd be amazing! And it'd be even better if you can take some more pictures this time!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Consider it done.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Puca! Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: *whimper*... I never imagined I'd dig up an Armored Crab digging for gems...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Armored Crab? Isn't that a vishap?)

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: It's fine, fine, I'm not hurt... Sorry for making you worry...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Good thing this vishap showed up! Gobbled that nasty crab right up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!? Vishaps eat giant crabs?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's what you're focused on?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Maybe they don't actually like crab that much, it doesn't look too thrilled...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's what you're focused on?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh right! We should be focusing on... why is there a vishap here?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: No clue! Never seen one around these parts before.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette warned us that while some vishaps are super friendly, others can be really dangerous, so we shouldn't get too close.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Whew... Seems I'm pretty lucky, running into such a cute vishap like this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Cute... vishap? ...Wait...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then be sure to give it a proper thank you the next time you run into it, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Yeah, for sure! And I'll treat it to something tasty too! Only thing is that I'm not sure what it likes... Definitely not giant crabs, though!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tidalga.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Tidalga? Wouldn't have thought such a big vishap would like something...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Whoa! Tidalga! When did that get there!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? So this pile of Tidalga isn't yours?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Nope! Haven't even had a chance to dive in yet... Did some kind soul overhear us and leave it here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps some nice fairy.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Looks like I really am super lucky today! Can't believe that fashion magazine horoscope was actually accurate...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Then may the stars watch over us, that our gift may arrive safe and sound!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It will, certainly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, here! These are the Beryl Conches we gathered. Are these enough?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Plenty! Whoooa, so sparkly, I can barely open my eyes...

choices.text: Laying it on a bit thick, aren't we?

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hehe, that's just how I like to express how grateful I am!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Well then, with my gems, your Beryl Conches, and the nice fairy's Tidalga, my mission here is complete!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: If everything goes this well, the clothes should be ready in a couple days!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hey, when we deliver the clothes to the Palais Mermonia, will you two come see what we made?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Of course.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hehe, let's meet up at the Palais Mermonia then! A whole bunch of us Melusines will be there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds great! We'll be looking forward to hearing from you!

choices.text: Had to wear shades the whole time I was looking.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Really? Then I'm buying a pair too, should help with gem-hunting...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Don't buy {M#his}{F#her} nonsense! Not a word of it's true!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it's been a long time since Paimon's seen the Palais Mermonia this busy! Puca wasn't kidding, there are a ton of Melusines...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Something's off, though. Everyone feels kinda... tense?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Um, excuse me? Miss...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Mr. Gestionnaire! Do you enjoy your work here in the Palais Mermonia?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Uh, are you... are you asking me?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Err, well, about that, I can't really say I'm happy, or particularly unhappy... Though I've been here for some time now, I still feel as though I only just started...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Got it, so put another way... Work at the Palais Mermonia is so exciting that it feels as though you're always filled with energy — like you're in your prime, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Exciting? Oh, no, no! More anxious, really...

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: An exciting anxiety? Is being a Gestionnaire really that nerve-wracking? And here I thought only the Marechaussee Phantom was like that.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no! It musn't be exciting. If anything on the job excites your nerves, that means the process has already gone terribly wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Is that so? Sedile never mentioned anything like that.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Sedile... Ah, you mean Officer Sedile of the Marechaussee Phantom? Wait, are you her colleague?

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: Of course not! If we're talking ability, I definitely would've passed the exam first!

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Granna, now's not the time to get competitive! Look at the poor man, he's so nervous he's sweating bullets.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Really? I thought that if someone looks really nervous during an interview, that means you're asking the right questions.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Ahem! Excuse me, Mr. Gestionnaire, are there any troubles in your work life that you find difficult to discuss?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Pardon me, but, interview? Am I being interviewed right now?

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Well, yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Oh, no. Oh no no no no...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: According to regulations, Gestionnaires are strictly forbidden from giving private interviews, especially to parties of unknown provenance...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Excuse me, Miss Melusine, but might I inquire your full name and the newspaper at which you are currently employed?

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Uh... Special Reporter Laume, for the "Buoyant Otter Gazette"!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: (You obviously just made that up...! Laume, what happened to truth in reporting!?)

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Hmm... Does the Court of Fontaine really have a paper like that? I'll... I need to go check the files...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: My good sir, are you feeling alright? You certainly look as though your nerves have been excited right now...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: ...Right, the process! Sorry, good ladies, could you please wait here for a moment? I need to go find a colleague from the publishing office...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: (Oh, for... We were just going to ask him how to get to Monsieur Neuvillette's office... Yet somehow, it turned into a practice interview for Laume...)

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Mr. Iaune! There you are!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: The tea Miss Cornelia so kindly made for us is nearly cold, just what have you... Oh my word! What happened here? Why are there so many Melusines?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Ah! Mr. Roialte, please, give me a hand. I can't possibly take care of all these Melusines myself, much less give an interview while I'm at it...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Interview? I never saw any such thing on the schedule. Which newspaper?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune & Laume
dialogues.text: The "Buoyant Otter Gazette."

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Ah? Really? Yet what you're holding certainly doesn't look like an otter.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Of course not! This happens to be the one we're looking for this time.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Eh? This blue creature can't be me, can it? Looks nothing like me...

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: HEY! Watch what you're calling a blue creature. This is none other than the eminent Monsieur Neuvillette!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Eh!?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Mr. Iaune, please refrain from undue alarm. I understand that your heavy workload and lack of sleep might have left you rather tightly wound, but you must remain calm.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: As you well know, the world looks profoundly different through Melusine eyes. Thus, it is entirely possible that to them, the Iudex appears... well, like that.

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: Mmm, pretty much! Monsieur Neuvillette actually looks a bit different to every Melusine, so we split the difference.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Ah, you split the difference? I see, a most judicious approach.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: In that case, might I inquire what matter you wish to see Monsieur Neuvillette about?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: We're here to give him a g...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: ...Gun salute! A 21-gun salute for Monsieur Neuvillette, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: (Phew! That was a close call, we almost told someone else about the secret gift again!)

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: ...A—A gun salute? Inside the Palais Mermonia? Inside the Iudex's office?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Mr. Roialte, please calm down, you're also becoming unduly alarmed...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, err, can you say something? Paimon's getting scared...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry. I'm naturally the silent type.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Please don't make Paimon beg! Stop rubbernecking!

choices.text: It feels like I'm watching a play unfold in real time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not that Paimon can't sympathize, but it looks like Roialte's really about to call the Gardes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And if he really calls Neuvillette over, then the surprise they worked so hard to prepare will be for nothing, and things'll get waaay more awkward...

choices.text: Fine, you've convinced me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you mean "this"? Do what exactly!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Heya, Puca, everyone, so great to see you all here!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon!

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: ...Mr. Roialte?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Pardon me, but are you with them?

choices.text: We are. We agreed to visit Neuvillette together.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Everything should be in order, then. Monsieur Neuvillette is currently in his office, and should not be receiving any other guests at this time. You may proceed.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: What, we don't need to confirm their identities and so on?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: There's no need.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Would you look at that? Mr. Iaune keeps his nose so firmly to the grindstone that he seldom has a chance to look up and register all the Palais Mermonia's esteemed visitors...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's fine, we're the ones imposing...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: You're too gracious. We shan't delay you or your Melusine friends any longer, save for one minor thing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Wazzat?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: While inside the Palais Mermonia, particularly in the offices, please ensure that any items you're holding remain below head level.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Otherwise, our most enthusiastic colleagues will doubtlessly assume you have a special request you plan to seek assistance with.

response.speaker: Flo
response.text: Got it! We were only holding it because everyone was scared of getting lost in the Court of Fontaine, but now that we've reached our destination... Puca, if you would...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Sure, Flo! Putting it away...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhh! So that's what it was for!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's fine! With the two of us here, there's no way you're getting lost! Come on, Neuvillette's office is right over there...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Mr. Roialte...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: #No need for the long face! That's {NICKNAME}, a good friend of the Iudex. No trouble will come of it.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: And even if something does happen, it will have had nothing to do with you or me. We were both drinking Miss Cornelia's tea.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Ah, it's you.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! Feels like ages since I last saw you. How've you been?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: All's well, things've been going great.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Haa, that's great to hear! As you can see, this place hasn't changed a bit...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Heh.... Pardon me, but are you with the Melusines?

choices.text: We are. We agreed to visit Neuvillette together.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Point is... Wonderful! The problem has suddenly solved itself.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Monsieur Neuvillette is currently in his office, and should not be receiving any other guests at this time. You may proceed.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sorry to impose...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: You're too gracious. We shan't delay you or your Melusine friends any longer, save for one minor thing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Wazzat?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: While inside the Palais Mermonia, particularly in the offices, please ensure that any items you're holding remain below head level.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Otherwise, our most enthusiastic colleagues will doubtlessly assume you have a special request you plan to seek assistance with.

response.speaker: Flo
response.text: Got it! We were only holding it because everyone was scared of getting lost in the Court of Fontaine, but now that we've reached our destination... Puca, if you would...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Sure, Flo! Putting it away...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhh! So that's what it was for!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's fine! With the two of us here, there's no way you're getting lost! Come on, Neuvillette's office is right over there...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Please, take care, everyone.

choices.text: We are. We agreed to visit a certain blue creature together.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Hahaha, so you heard everything. Merely a slip of the tongue, I assure you. You wouldn't dream of telling anyone, yes?

choices.text: We are. We agreed to visit a certain blue creature together.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Hahaha... So, you were listening.

choices.text: Let's do this!
Sorry, lost myself for a second.

talks.objective: Talk to Puca and take the Melusines to see Neuvillette

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Okay then, please lead the way to Monsieur Neuvillette's office!

choices.text: Follow me, and stay close to the group, no wandering, thank you...
Just a moment.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Sure, we'll wait!

talks.objective: Take the Melusines to see Neuvillette

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Ah, I thought it might be you.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I had heard Melusine voices, and went to the window for a look... Only to find the angle was wrong, and I couldn't see a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: ...I trust you encountered no difficulties on your way?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, not at all! Uh, well, not exactly...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You briefly fill Neuvillette in on what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: *ahem* ...Laume, you were indeed the first at fault here. You must secure the consent of others before making requests, and mustn't impede their duties or daily lives.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Extra caution should be exercised with matters such as interviews.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: I see... I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And the "Buoyant Otter Gazette" desperately needs rebranding.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The what Gazette?

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: It's nothing! I—I'll go find them both and apologize right now!

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Hey, remember to greet them politely first, even when you're apologizing!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: (Yes, that should suffice... Lecturing's never been my strong suit...)

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Now, back to the matter at hand. How might I help you all today?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... It's probably best if the Melusines tell you themselves!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: (Oh, zounds! We were all so busy making the gift, we never stopped to plan how to actually give it to Monsieur Neuvillette so it feels like a surprise!)

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: (It'd be perfect if we could actually give a gun salute right about now! KA-BOOM BOOM, it'd be totally... wait, no! No gun salutes allowed in offices, right?)

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: (If only Laume was here, she's so carefree... Laume, come on, it's our hour of need!)

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: I'm baack! Those two gentlemen are both great people! They not only didn't scold me, but they even served me tea, too!

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Huh? Why haven't you given him the clothes yet? I already finished two whole cups!

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: (AAH! She just said it like it was nothing!)

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Clothes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, uhm... That's, um...

choices.text: You've come this far.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Yeah, you're right...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The Melusines practically fall over themselves as they cheerfully clamor to explain the "surprise gift" and how it all came about...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Yet for reasons unknown, both givers and recipient remained a touch awkward.

choices.text: Just give it to him!

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: I'm telling you, I saw it in a magazine before...

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: Uh, you sure? You're not making it up, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Come on out, now. It's me.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: New Valet, Pahsiv! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's Pahsiv! So, you know Neuvillette?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: "Pahsiv"? This is how you address her, then?

choices.text: Wait, does this mean the legendary "new valet" is none other than...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's what she meant!? Oh... And to think that it used to keep Paimon up at night, tossing and turning... Even lost sleep over it...

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hello...?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Waah... Melusine... ka-pow...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Puca, allow me to introduce you. This here is the nice vishap... Err, nice vishap lady who helped you before.

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Whoa, vishaps can turn into Melusines? That's so cool! Now we can hold hands!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Thank you for saving me. How about I treat you to a nice meal?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Tide... Tidalga?

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Hmm? Yeah! Tidalga!

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Tidalga! Tidalga! Tidalga Tidalga!

response.speaker: Flo
response.text: I take it you really like Tidalga?

response.speaker: Virda
response.text: Wait, that means you gave us your favorite food... Wow! Thank you so, so much!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Thank you, Pahsiv.

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv, New Valet, ka-pow!

response.speaker: Flo
response.text: If that's the case, why not picnic here with us?

response.speaker: Laume
response.text: I'll handle the food! I caused everyone so much trouble back at the Palais Mermonia, it's the least I can do!

response.speaker: Puca
response.text: Then I'll prep some tidalga for Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Everyone works hard to prepare the delicious meal before enjoying it together.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: And though Pahsiv basically ate nothing but tidalga (and polished off every last bite), her delight was plain for all to see.

choices.text: We'll have to tell Cyno first chance we get.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good call, he'll think of it as a challenge...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Thanks so much for your help, and stay safe!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Communicating with Melusines always requires a bit more effort. The usual methods simply aren't very effective...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: There's something else I've been wondering... Can't seem to wrap my head around it.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: And what's that?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Think about it! Melusines are all so kind and clever, and they live practically forever! They're perfectly suited for our line of work, aren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Iaune, my dear boy...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: You just listed every reason they'd make disastrous Gestionnaires.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look over there, it's a Melusine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What is she doing? Could she be in trouble? Let's go see!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Locked on: The shiniest, brightest Beryl Conches!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, any shell that shiny even underwater has gotta be quality!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice, shells secured! Not a single hiccup!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Aah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! What was that? Puca might really be in trouble, let's go back and check on her!

dialogues.speaker: Cornelia
dialogues.text: Where could Roialte and Iaune possibly have gone off too... Eh? What are all these Melusines doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: Is today Melusine family visitation day?

dialogues.speaker: Imena
dialogues.text: Quite the hubbub. Almost as busy as the end-of-quarter reimbursement period.
